name: askdock-mobile-tall-crush
description: ask dock on a phone, as the transcript's trailing row: option label lines never overlap the details below them and wrap inside the neutral frame however long or unbroken they are; the dock sizes to its content with no internal scroll; the tall batch extends the transcript's own scroll region without changing any pane allocation

allowlist..attention: StatusDot classes are prefixed statusdot- in resolved.css, so Card and StatusDot share no selector or geometry.

mutation.declaration: askquestioncard.module.css: .optionRow { overflow-wrap: break-word } - reverting it lets the harness's unbroken-token label escape the card horizontally (assertion B)
mutation.note: Containment comes from the transcript scroller, not the dock. The label assertions exercise the grid option rows and their wrapping copy stacks; the unbroken-token label makes removal of overflow-wrap observable.
